validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE (confirmed): The gem.wiki page's ONLY citations are two generic OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletins that do NOT name this line, so the sheet's own support was effectively nil (existence red flag on paper). Independent research resolves it: the Waqr manifold is a real facility in the southern Ghawar / Haradh sweet-gas gathering system. Two independent trade sources agree: Offshore Technology (offshore-technology.com/projects/haradh) states 'The Waqr and Tinat manifolds are located 50km and 44km, respectively, from the plant' and that gas reaches Haradh via 'five 20in and 30in gas transmission lines that total 130km'; Oil & Gas Journal (ogj.com Haradh gas plant article) independently states 'The Waqr manifold is 50 km from the plant and gathers sweet gas.' So the physical Waqr->Haradh line is real. CLASSIFICATION (ok, caveat): functionally this is a field-manifold-to-plant sweet-gas line, but Aramco/OT explicitly call the Waqr/Tinat/Haradh lines 'gas transmission lines', so tracking it as gas transmission is defensible; it is NOT oil/NGL/condensate and NOT plant-internal. DUPLICATE (none): distinct from siblings — P1920 Tinat Kuff-Haradh (44km, 20in) is the Tinat manifold line ('44km'), P1917/1918/1919 Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah are the Haradh-manifold-to-Hawiyah lines; Waqr is its own 50km manifold line. GulfPub SA gas roster (20 features) has NO Waqr/Haradh gathering line, so no GulfPub duplicate/relabel. ATTRIBUTION (confirmed): owner/operator Saudi Aramco 100% (entire Haradh/Ghawar sweet-gas system is wholly Aramco); Fuel=Gas correct (explicitly 'sweet gas'); region Eastern Province (Haradh, Al-Ahsa, southern Ghawar). SPEC: Length 50km = HIGH (both OT and OGJ independently state 50 km, agreeing with GEM). Diameter 30in = MEDIUM (sources give the manifold-to-plant set as a mix of '20in and 30in' lines but do not pin 30in to the Waqr line specifically; plausible split is Waqr=30in / Tinat=20in given P1920 Tinat=20in, but unconfirmed). Capacity blank and not fillable — sources give only the aggregate 130km/five-line figure, no per-line throughput; left blank. Startup ~2003-2004 (Haradh gas plant on stream Apr-Jun 2003), consistent with status=operating.

routes.start_name: Waqr manifold (Waqr gas field, southern Ghawar)
routes.corridor_desc: Southern Ghawar, Eastern Province (Al-Ahsa governorate) of Saudi Arabia. The line runs ~50 km from the Waqr sweet-gas manifold to the Haradh Gas Plant near Haradh town. End (Haradh plant/town) is well located at ~24.14N, 49.08E (Wikipedia/Saudipedia/OT all place Haradh gas plant at the southern tip of Ghawar, ~280-300 km SW of Dhahran). Start (Waqr manifold) is one of the southern Ghawar gas fields ~50 km from the plant, but no independent source gives its exact coordinates, so start lat/lon left null; corridor is bounded to a ~50 km radius arc south/southwest of the Haradh plant within the south Ghawar field belt. Loose bound only.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from two independent trade sources (Waqr manifold 50 km from Haradh plant, gathering sweet gas). Haradh Gas Plant coordinates are defensible from public geography (Haradh town/plant, southern Ghawar). Waqr manifold exact coordinates not independently sourced -> lat/lon left null, no coordinate fabricated. Exact routing (well corridor) unknown; suggested accuracy low.
